name: CME Bitcoin Futures Basis & Term Structure Analysis
description: Analyzes the CME Bitcoin futures basis (futures vs spot spread) and term structure. Computes the cash-and-carry basis as a percentage of spot, the M1/M2 carry signal from the term structure, and tracks cumulative basis cost. Includes a summary table with key metrics (avg/current/max/min basis, carry stats), time series charts of basis and carry, and a histogram of basis distribution. Uses NoAdjustment continuation to preserve actual futures price levels for meaningful basis computation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CME BITCOIN FUTURES BASIS & TERM STRUCTURE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Compares CME Bitcoin futures (BT) to spot BTCUSD to measure:
#   1. Cash-and-carry basis: (futures - spot) / spot
#   2. Term structure carry: M1/M2 ratio from futures_continuation
#   3. Cumulative basis cost over time
#
# Uses NoAdjustment so futures prices are actual traded levels,
# enabling meaningful basis computation against spot.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
# CME Bitcoin Futures (unadjusted for basis calculation)
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

futures_close = cont.c

# Spot BTC from Coinbase
spot = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
spot_close = spot.c

# --- Basis Calculations ---
# Raw basis in USD
basis_usd = futures_close - spot_close

# Basis as percentage of spot (the "annualizable" premium)
basis_pct = basis_usd / spot_close

# Smoothed basis (30-day MA) for trend visibility
basis_pct_smooth = ma(period=30)(basis_pct)

# --- Term Structure / Carry ---
# M1/M2 carry from futures_continuation (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)
carry = cont.carry

# Calendar spread (front - 2nd nearby)
calendar_spread = cont.spread

# Smoothed carry (30-day MA)
carry_smooth = ma(period=30)(carry)

# --- Cumulative Basis Cost ---
# Track compounded basis cost: if you held futures vs spot, how much premium leaked
# Each day's basis_pct approximates the daily cost; cumulate for total cost
cumulative_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(basis_pct)

# --- Timestamps for charts ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Key Basis & Carry Metrics ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='CME BTC Futures Basis & Carry Summary',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Avg Basis (%)', 'Current Basis (%)', 'Max Basis (%)', 'Min Basis (%)', 'Avg Carry (M1/M2)'],
        col_headers=['Value', 'Detail'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Basis Summary',
    order=0
)(basis_pct, basis_pct, basis_pct, basis_usd, basis_pct, basis_usd, basis_pct, basis_usd, carry, carry)

# --- 2. XY Lines: Basis (%) Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='CME BTC Futures Basis (% of Spot)',
    category='2. Basis & Carry Over Time',
    y_axis_label='Basis (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Daily Basis (%)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='30d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero (Parity)', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, basis_pct, basis_pct_smooth)

# --- 3. XY Lines: Carry (M1/M2 Term Structure) & Cumulative Basis ---
xy_lines(
    title='Term Structure Carry & Cumulative Basis Cost',
    category='2. Basis & Carry Over Time',
    y_axis_label='Value',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry (M1/M2)', color=Color.Indigo),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry 30d MA', color=Color.Violet, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Basis Cost', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, carry, carry_smooth, cumulative_basis)

# --- 4. Histogram: Distribution of Daily Basis (%) ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of Daily Futures Basis (%)',
    category='3. Basis Distribution',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Basis (% of Spot)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=0
)(basis_pct)
